name: spider-queries
description: A benchmark for translating natural language questions into SQL queries across multiple database schemas, measuring semantic parsing and cross-domain text-to-SQL performance. It evaluates a model's ability to produce correct, executable SQL given varied schemas and complex NL queries. Typical use is automated evaluation via exact-match of predicted SQL or execution results against gold queries.
reputation: Widely used in the semantic-parsing and text-to-SQL community as a cross-domain SQL generation evaluation.
